imps.name: Amdusias
imps.rule: On your play, play any available card and make its suit the led suit. This overrides card-choice restrictions. Players still to act follow the new suit; previously played cards remain eligible under it. Trump is unchanged.

imps.name: Valefor
imps.rule: After winning a trick, exchange one chosen available card from your remaining hand with one random available card from an opponent’s hand.

imps.name: Furfur
imps.rule: When playing into an ongoing trick, suppress trump’s winning advantage for that trick. Your card must be legal. The highest card of the final led suit wins, except that The Hanged Man’s high/low choice still applies.

imps.name: Bael
imps.rule: On your play, play one legal card face down; reveal it after everyone plays, before awarding the trick. If leading, truthfully announce its suit. An already exposed card may be concealed this way.

imps.name: Dantalion
imps.rule: After winning a trick, privately inspect two random available cards from one opponent’s remaining hand, then return them.

imps.name: Agares
imps.rule: On your turn, before playing, return any previously played card in the current trick to its owner. They choose a different legal replacement, treating the returned card as absent when determining legality. If none exists, the original stays. Your use is spent either way; then play your card.

imps.name: Shax
imps.rule: On your turn, choose another player still to act in this trick. On their turn, they play a random available card, ignoring follow-suit and other card-choice restrictions.

imps.name: Balam
imps.rule: Before bidding, privately inspect three random available cards from one opponent’s hand, then return them.

imps.name: Seere
imps.rule: After winning a trick, choose another player to lead the next trick. Ownership of the completed trick is unchanged.

imps.name: Andromalius
imps.rule: After every trick you win, you may expose one random, previously unexposed available card from an opponent’s remaining hand. It stays face up until played, even if exchanged. This power is repeatable.

arcana.name: The Fool
arcana.rule: After normal discards, before bidding, each player may discard one additional chosen card and draw a random replacement from the reserve. Choose the outgoing card before drawing; it goes to discards, not the reserve.

arcana.name: The Magician
arcana.rule: Before normal discards, each player may exchange one chosen hand card for a random reserve card. Choose the outgoing card first, draw the replacement, then mix the outgoing card into the reserve. Resolve clockwise from the dealer’s left.

arcana.name: The High Priestess
arcana.rule: Before bidding, each player may privately inspect two random cards from another player’s hand, then return them.

arcana.name: The Empress
arcana.rule: Immediately after winning their first trick, each player may increase their bid by one. Declining then forfeits the opportunity.

arcana.name: The Emperor
arcana.rule: Every trick, its leader may declare Royal Command as they lead. Every follower must play the highest card of whichever suit they legally play: highest led-suit card if able to follow, otherwise highest of their chosen suit. Amdusias and Shax override this restriction when using their powers.

arcana.name: The Hierophant
arcana.rule: If unable to follow suit, a player must play designated trump if available. No overtrumping is required. This obligation remains when Furfur suppresses trump advantage.

arcana.name: The Lovers
arcana.rule: Before bidding, each player secretly chooses another player; reveal choices at scoring. If chooser and chosen player both make their contracts exactly, the chooser recovers two points. Mutual selection is unnecessary.

arcana.name: The Chariot
arcana.rule: Each trick’s winner must lead their highest-ranked available card next trick; choose freely among tied ranks. The first leader and a substitute leader appointed by Seere are unrestricted. Amdusias may override the lead restriction with his power.

arcana.name: Strength
arcana.rule: Every trick is won by the highest card of the final led suit, regardless of trump.

arcana.name: The Hermit
arcana.rule: Before bidding, each player may secretly reserve one retained card for the final trick. It is unavailable until then and must be played as that player’s final card. Its owner may inspect it.

arcana.name: Wheel of Fortune
arcana.rule: Each player making an exact contract recovers one point.

arcana.name: Justice
arcana.rule: Undershooting a bid costs double the normal penalty. Overshooting costs the normal penalty.

arcana.name: The Hanged Man
arcana.rule: As they lead each trick, its leader chooses whether the highest or lowest eligible card wins. If effective trump is present, compare only trumps; otherwise compare cards of the final led suit. Changing the led suit or suppressing trump does not change the chosen direction.

arcana.name: Death
arcana.rule: The final physical trick counts twice for its winner. With T physical tricks, bids range from 0 through T + 1 and the dealer’s hook applies to T + 1. It is impossible for everyone to make their contract.

arcana.name: Temperance
arcana.rule: Once per player per round, immediately after winning a trick, adjust your bid up or down by one. This may be used after the final trick, before scoring.

arcana.name: The Devil
arcana.rule: Before bidding, each last-place player secretly chooses an opponent; reveal choices at scoring. If that opponent misses, recover half their actual round penalty, rounded down. Add your own round penalty before applying recovery.

arcana.name: The Tower
arcana.rule: First-place players pay double their normal round penalty for missing.

arcana.name: The Star
arcana.rule: Eligible players may miss by exactly one trick in either direction without penalty. An error of two or more costs the full normal penalty. A forgiven miss is not an exact contract.

arcana.name: The Moon
arcana.rule: Submit bids secretly and reveal simultaneously; the dealer’s hook is suspended. Each last-place player may then adjust their bid up or down by one.

arcana.name: The Sun
arcana.rule: Each exact contract recovers five points, or ten for a player who began in last place.

arcana.name: Judgement
arcana.rule: After normal initial bidding with the dealer’s hook, each last-place player may adjust their bid up or down by one or two. The adjustment is exempt from the hook.

arcana.name: The World
arcana.rule: Each player making an exact contract erases their largest original round penalty from rounds 1–4. Earlier recoveries remain credited. Erase only one round; tied largest penalties allow a choice. Floor the final total at zero.
